heading: Start here — your first 2 hours
definition: What MechaLab is: this course's browser workbench. Python 3.12 and the circuit simulators run inside the tab, with nothing to install and no account.
linkLabel: Read Lesson 1: Variables and data types →
note: When to use it: any time a lesson hands you a starter file — Tab 2 lists every lesson and exercise that has one. Read the page for the idea, then type, run and verify in MechaLab; your progress stays in this browser, and nothing is saved on GitHub.
